course.title: Unit 5 Fun Clubs【例句】
course.description: SECTION A How do you choose a school club?

sentences.content: Hello! My name is Teng Fei, and I want to join the ping-pong club.
sentences.english: Hello ! My name is Teng Fei , and I want to join the ping-pong club
sentences.chinese: 你好！我叫Teng Fei，我想加入乒乓球俱乐部。

sentences.content: Great! Can you play ping-pong?
sentences.english: Great ! Can you play ping-pong ?
sentences.chinese: 太好了！你会打乒乓球吗？

sentences.content: Yes, I can.
sentences.english: Yes , I can
sentences.chinese: 是的，我可以。

sentences.content: We meet at 5 o'clock every Tuesday. Can you come?
sentences.english: We meet at 5 o'clock every Tuesday . Can you come ?
sentences.chinese: 我们每周二五点见面。你能来吗？

sentences.content: Hello! My name is Sam. I want to join the chess club.
sentences.english: Hello ! My name is Sam . I want to join the chess club
sentences.chinese: 你好！我叫Sam。我想加入国际象棋俱乐部。

sentences.content: Can you play Chinese chess?
sentences.english: Can you play Chinese chess ?
sentences.chinese: 你会下中国象棋吗？

sentences.content: No, I can't.
sentences.english: No , I can't
sentences.chinese: 不，我做不到。

sentences.content: It's OK. You can learn it here.
sentences.english: It's OK . You can learn it here
sentences.chinese: 没关系。你可以在这里学习。

sentences.content: Morning! My name is Lin Hua, and I want to join the drama club.
sentences.english: Morning ! My name is Lin Hua , and I want to join the drama club
sentences.chinese: 早上好！我叫Lin Hua，想加入戏剧社。

sentences.content: Can you read these words with feeling?
sentences.english: Can you read these words with feeling ?
sentences.chinese: 你能带着感情朗读这些词语吗？

sentences.content: Let me have a try.
sentences.english: Let me have a try
sentences.chinese: 让我试试。

sentences.content: Great! Come to Room 11 at 12:00 every Thursday.
sentences.english: Great ! Come to Room 11 at 12:00 every Thursday
sentences.chinese: 太好了！每周四12:00来11号房间。

sentences.content: Hi there! What club do you want to join?
sentences.english: Hi there ! What club do you want to join ?
sentences.chinese: 你好！你想加入什么社团？

sentences.content: I have no idea.
sentences.english: I have no idea
sentences.chinese: 我不知道。

sentences.content: Here's some good news! Our school wants to start a music club.
sentences.english: Here's some good news ! Our school wants to start a music club
sentences.chinese: 有个好消息！我们学校想成立一个音乐俱乐部。

wordDetails.definition: want（第三人称单数）: 想要

sentences.content: Do you want to join?
sentences.english: Do you want to join ?
sentences.chinese: 你想加入吗？

sentences.content: Sure. I can play the guitar.
sentences.english: Sure . I can play the guitar
sentences.chinese: 当然。我会弹吉他。

sentences.content: What about you, Emma?
sentences.english: What about you , Emma ?
sentences.chinese: 你呢，Emma？

sentences.content: I'd love to, but I can't play any musical instruments.
sentences.english: I'd love to , but I can't play any musical instruments
sentences.chinese: 我很想，但我不会演奏任何乐器。

sentences.content: Oh, but you can sing well.
sentences.english: Oh , but you can sing well
sentences.chinese: 哦，但你唱得真好。

sentences.content: Exactly!
sentences.english: Exactly !
sentences.chinese: 正是如此！

sentences.content: How about Ella? She can play the violin, right?
sentences.english: How about Ella ? She can play the violin , right ?
sentences.chinese: Ella怎么样？她会拉小提琴，对吧？

sentences.content: Yes, she can.
sentences.english: Yes , she can
sentences.chinese: 是的，她可以。

sentences.content: What instruments can you play, Teng Fei?
sentences.english: What instruments can you play , Teng Fei ?
sentences.chinese: Teng Fei，你会演奏什么乐器？

sentences.content: I can play the drums.
sentences.english: I can play the drums
sentences.chinese: 我会打鼓。

sentences.content: That's great! Let's go to the music room after school!
sentences.english: That's great ! Let's go to the music room after school !
sentences.chinese: 太好了！放学后我们去音乐教室吧！
